title: Exam Format Guide
objective: Know exactly what happens in each paper — no surprises on exam day.

sections.heading: Reading — 45 minutes, 6 parts, 32 questions
sections.body:
**Part 1**: five short real-world texts (signs, messages). Three-option multiple choice.
**Part 2**: matching — five people to eight descriptions (clubs, courses, books…).
**Part 3**: five multiple-choice questions about a longer text (four options).
**Part 4**: gapped text — five gaps, four options each (vocabulary in context).
**Part 5**: multiple-choice cloze — six gaps, four similar-word options.
**Part 6**: open cloze — six gaps, you write exactly one word per gap.
Marks: 1 per correct answer. Read instructions carefully and transfer answers accurately.
sections.bodyZh: 阅读45分钟，6部分32题。第1部分：短文本三选一；第2部分：配对（5人对8选项）；第3部分：长文四选一；第4部分：五空四选一；第5部分：六空近义四选一；第6部分：六空开放式填空（每空一词）。
sections.tip: Time guide: Parts 1–2 (10 min), Part 3 (10 min), Parts 4–5 (12 min), Part 6 (8 min), checking (5 min).

sections.heading: Writing — 45 minutes, 2 parts
sections.body:
**Part 1** (compulsory): reply to an email of about 100 words. You must cover all four content points.
**Part 2**: choose ONE task — an article or a story, about 100 words.
You are marked on Content, Communicative Achievement, Organisation and Language. Spend about 20–25 minutes on Part 1 and the rest on Part 2.
sections.bodyZh: 写作45分钟，2部分。第1部分必做：回复邮件约100词，四个内容点都要覆盖；第2部分二选一：文章或故事约100词。评分看内容、交际效果、组织和语言。
sections.tip: Plan 2–3 minutes before writing. Check the four content points one by one before moving on.

sections.heading: Listening — about 30 minutes, 4 parts, 25 questions
sections.body:
**Part 1**: seven short recordings, three picture options each.
**Part 2**: six short recordings, three-option multiple choice (main idea/detail).
**Part 3**: gap fill — six gaps in notes from a longer recording; write a word, number, date or time.
**Part 4**: six three-option questions about a longer interview or talk.
Each recording is played **twice**. You have a few seconds before each part to read the questions.
sections.bodyZh: 听力约30分钟，4部分25题。第1部分：7段短录音配图片三选一；第2部分：6段短录音三选一；第3部分：长录音笔记填空6题（写词、数字、日期或时间）；第4部分：长访谈6道三选一。每段录音放两遍。
sections.tip: Use the pre-listening seconds to predict: underline what you must listen for (name? number? reason?).

sections.heading: Speaking — 10–12 minutes, 4 parts (two candidates together)
sections.body:
**Part 1** (~2 min): the interlocutor asks you personal questions (name, home, hobbies, daily life).
**Part 2** (~3 min): describe a photograph for about one minute; your partner listens.
**Part 3** (~4 min): collaborative task — discuss picture prompts with your partner and reach a decision.
**Part 4** (~3 min): conversation about the Part 3 topic (opinions, experiences).
You are marked on Grammar & Vocabulary, Pronunciation, Discourse Management and Interactive Communication.
sections.bodyZh: 口语10-12分钟，4部分，两名考生一起。第1部分：个人问题；第2部分：看图描述约一分钟；第3部分：合作任务，与同伴讨论图片并达成一致；第4部分：围绕第3部分话题的讨论。
sections.tip: Never just answer — extend! Add a reason or example, then invite your partner: What do you think?

sections.heading: Scoring & results
sections.body:
Each of the four skills gets a Cambridge Scale score (120–170). Your overall result is the average of the four.
**140–159** = Pass (B1 certificate) · **160–170** = Pass with Distinction (shows B2 ability) · **120–139** = A2 level certificate.
There is no fail certificate below 120.
sections.bodyZh: 每项技能得到一个剑桥量表分（120-170），总成绩是四项平均。140-159 通过（B1证书）；160-170 优秀（显示B2水平）；120-139 获A2证书。
sections.tip: Aim for 145+ in every mock section to give yourself a safety margin.

keyPoints: Reading 45 min / 32 q · Writing 45 min / 2 tasks · Listening ~30 min / 25 q · Speaking 10–12 min.
Reading Part 6 and Listening Part 3 are written answers — spelling counts.
Speaking is paired: interact, don't monologue.
Pass = 140 average on the Cambridge Scale.
